text:
nina: Heads-up: Cloud marketplace listing for SurfaceAI needs a compliance bundle. Ask from partner: SOC2 scope summary, pen-test (redacted), vuln scan CSVs, vendor questionnaire, and a simple control->evidence index. They want presigned upload links by Thu next week.

sam: OK — do we have owners for each piece? Last time mapping slipped.

maria: I can own the control index and the scope summary. I'll pull the SOC artifacts from the vault and mark versions.

ben: I'll do the pen-test redaction pass. The 2025-11 pen has hostnames and an attached log snippet. Legal, confirm what we can redact/share?

legal: Confirmed: share redacted versions only. Keep findings and remediation notes; remove raw logs, internal IPs, and account identifiers. Add a redaction_notice.txt in the ZIP.

jack: I'll provision a temp S3 bucket and generate presigned POSTs. Suggest presign TTL 72h and temp bucket lifecycle 21d. We'll copy a sealed archive to rw-compliance-archive with 1y retention. Any objections?

nina: Sounds fine. Partner wants a single ZIP per artifact group (e.g., soc2.zip, pen-redacted.zip, scans.zip). Include a manifest file listing filenames and hashes.

maria: For the index, I'll produce NDJSON lines with fields: filename, type, owner, redacted(Y/N), sha256, note. Easier for reviewers to consume.

sam: For questionnaire, I'll re-run last submitted answers and annotate any changes. Will attach a one-pager summary.

security-bot: Auto-scan: pen/pen-2025-11.pdf flagged internal hostnames on pages 3-4 and cloud account IDs on page 9. Vulnerability CSVs show 3 high findings that were remediated in 2026-01; indicate remediated status in manifest.

ben: I'll redact flagged pages and produce redaction_log.csv with byte ranges + rationale. Also will add an attestation file `attestation.txt` with: "I certify redactions performed per legal guidance."

legal: Please ensure attestation includes compliance contact: compliance+marketplace@redwood.ai. Also include statement about retention and access limitations.

jack: Example presign snippet I'll provide:
aws s3api create-presigned-post --bucket rw-evidence-surfaceai-temp --key "{artifact_group}/${filename}" --expires-in 259200

maria: Good. I'll add scope_and_summary.md inside soc2.zip and controls_map.md listing controls -> evidence file + owner.

nina: Action list: ben -> redaction + redaction_log (due Tue), maria -> control index + scope (due Tue), jack -> bucket + presigns + README (due Wed), sam -> questionnaire signoff (due Wed). Share links Thu.

ben: Noted. If the pen contains any customer data, I'll escalate immediately.

security-bot: Event recorded: marketplace-evidence-surfaceai-2300123456. Presign window 72h; temp retention 21d; archive retention 365d.

sam: Partner also requested contact for follow-ups and a short product blurb. I'll supply `compliance+marketplace@redwood.ai` and a 2-sentence blurb.

maria: I'll push drafts to GH under compliance/surfaceai/ and ping this thread when ready.

nina: Thanks team. Keep redaction notes explicit; reviewers ask about what changed. Tag me if legal needs to re-review. :thumbsup:
